questions.question: Which suppliers provide the parts of the desk cable management system that a reviewer praises for its rubber grommets?

chunks.quote: The cable management system is particularly ingenious, with rubber grommets that prevent cable fraying.

questions.sql: SELECT DISTINCT s.name FROM products p JOIN assemblies a ON a.product_id = p.product_id JOIN components c ON c.assembly_id = a.assembly_id JOIN part_supplier_mapping m ON m.part_id = c.part_id JOIN suppliers s ON s.supplier_id = m.supplier_id WHERE p.product_name = 'Malmö Desk' AND a.component_name = 'Cable Management'
questions.note: Text to records: the review is of the Malmö Desk; its Cable Management assembly (A-1064) has four parts (cable tray, cable clips, zip ties, adhesive pads), each with two suppliers, six suppliers in all.

questions.question: One reviewer admits attaching a chair's back rest upside down. Which preferred suppliers provide the parts of that back rest?

chunks.quote: I had attached the back rest upside down

questions.sql: SELECT DISTINCT s.name FROM products p JOIN assemblies a ON a.product_id = p.product_id JOIN components c ON c.assembly_id = a.assembly_id JOIN part_supplier_mapping m ON m.part_id = c.part_id JOIN suppliers s ON s.supplier_id = m.supplier_id WHERE p.product_name = 'Stockholm Chair' AND a.component_name = 'Back Rest' AND m.preferred_supplier
questions.note: The review is of the Stockholm Chair; its Back Rest assembly (A-1038) has five parts, one preferred supplier each. The supplier table spells SUP-001 'Nordic Wood Industries'; the mapping file writes 'nordic Wood Industries', the same supplier.

questions.question: Which product's parts come from the largest number of different suppliers?
questions.sql: SELECT p.product_name FROM products p JOIN assemblies a ON a.product_id = p.product_id JOIN components c ON c.assembly_id = a.assembly_id JOIN part_supplier_mapping m ON m.part_id = c.part_id GROUP BY p.product_name ORDER BY count(DISTINCT m.supplier_id) DESC LIMIT 1
questions.note: Uppsala Sofa 12 suppliers; Malmö Desk and Stockholm Chair 10; Linköping Bed and Helsingborg Dresser 8; Örebro Lamp and Gothenburg Table 6. The Linköping Bed has the most parts (35) but fewer suppliers. Three products have no parts in the records.

questions.question: What is the average star rating of the Örebro Lamp reviews?
questions.note: Seven reviews: 5 + 4 + 3 + 5 + 2 + 4 + 5 = 28, and 28 / 7 = 4.0. An answer of 4 or 4.0 out of 5 is right.

questions.question: Which parts of the Uppsala Sofa's frame take their preferred supplier more than 20 days to deliver?
questions.sql: SELECT DISTINCT c.part_name FROM products p JOIN assemblies a ON a.product_id = p.product_id JOIN components c ON c.assembly_id = a.assembly_id JOIN part_supplier_mapping m ON m.part_id = c.part_id WHERE p.product_name = 'Uppsala Sofa' AND a.component_name = 'Frame' AND m.preferred_supplier AND m.lead_time_days > 20
questions.note: Lead time is read as delivery time. Support Slats (preferred supplier, exactly 20 days) is on the boundary and does not count; the non-preferred supplier's 26 days for it is not asked for.

questions.question: Which products under $300 do reviewers say have sharp edges?

chunks.quote: the edges are a bit sharper than I'd prefer
the edges of the desk are a bit sharp

questions.note: The Linköping Bed review also reports edges that were a bit sharp, but the bed costs $790.

questions.question: Which products did @architect_amy review?
questions.note: @architect_amy (Seattle) appears once. @woodworker_amy (Portland) is a different reviewer whose reviews (Gothenburg Table, Helsingborg Dresser, Linköping Bed, Norrköping Nightstand) must not be counted.

questions.question: How many Jönköping Coffee Table reviews say its surface scratches easily?
questions.note: Two other reviews mention scratches only to deny them: "The surface is resistant to water rings and scratches" (#0) and "remarkably resistant to scratches and water marks" (#6); they do not count. The chipping veneer in #4 is not a scratch.

questions.question: How deep are the Västerås Bookshelf's shelves, in centimeters, according to a reviewer?

chunks.quote: The shelf depth of 30cm accommodates larger art books

questions.note: Nearby numbers are not the depth: 30-35 books per shelf (#1) and about 20kg per shelf (#3).

questions.question: What did customer service tell the Helsingborg Dresser reviewer who found that several panels were warped?

expected.text: To disassemble everything already assembled and return the entire dresser to the store.

chunks.quote: several of the panels were warped
they told me I'd have to disassemble everything I'd already done and return the entire thing to the store

questions.note: Other Helsingborg reviewers got different replies ("some issues with a supplier", "aware of issues with a recent batch of drawer hardware"); those are not this reviewer's.
